title: Navi Pillay Awarded 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for International Justice Work
detail: South African former UN Human Rights Commissioner Navi Pillay was awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her lifelong work in international justice and human rights. During her tenure as UN High Commissioner for Human Rights (2008–2014), Pillay was a prominent advocate for accountability in conflict zones and spoke out against human rights abuses globally. The Nobel Committee cited her decades of service as a judge at the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda, the International Criminal Court, and her leadership at the UN as foundational contributions to the global human rights architecture.
